scope: Literature review, small-data ingestion and a public-ring feasibility probe; no new tenfold result

claims.statement: Generic observable lifting, discrepancy-corrected optimization, differentiable tracking and memory closures have substantial established prior art.
claims.boundary: This does not decide priority for the separate exact nonlinear-Hamiltonian classifications.

claims.statement: DAMA-BAX reports about forty times fewer tracking acquisitions including final validation than its NSGA-II comparison.
claims.boundary: Not a proven all-in wall-clock gain or tenfold advantage over every modern adaptive comparator; original SSRL-X assets not verified public.

claims.statement: Free-space PIF reports about twelve-fold propagation savings in a long-time beam example at comparable radius/emittance behavior.
claims.boundary: Different discretizations; nonoptimized paper PIC comparator; optimized modern PIC and short-lattice transfer unproved.

claims.statement: Small licensed assets were downloaded or range-inspected and checked for hashes, numeric shapes, duplicate/conflicting inputs and declared provenance.
claims.boundary: No bulk-data, simulator-accuracy, counterfactual controller or facility validation inferred.

claims.statement: The source-bound 32-cell public HMBA ring gives identical individual/batched tracking states for the declared 64-point, 128-turn probe.
claims.boundary: Warm single-thread probe, no RF/radiation/space charge/errors; not an acceptance convergence or optimization result.

claims.statement: Adopt multipointBAX on a public ring benchmark, comparing full costs against strong adaptive and surrogate competitors, before attempting a certificate enhancement.
claims.boundary: A design brief, not a frozen completed optimizer experiment or a new general algorithm.

claims.statement: For H=q*p^3, q belongs to the polynomial dynamic core but its Poisson orbit is infinite-dimensional; exact core membership alone does not imply finite observable closure.
claims.boundary: Formal polynomial statement only; no global operator-domain, physical simulator, industrial performance or new classification-maximality claim.

claims.statement: Pinned unchanged bosonic-gsim Fig8 and Fig10 small examples ran successfully; maximum recorded Fock and single-mode phase/grid residuals were 5.56e-16 and 2.00e-15.
claims.boundary: Only the distributed small examples; no industrial gain, exhaustive test pass, largest-run reproduction or new algorithm claim.

claims.statement: For nonnegative weights, the weighted and origin-connected finite-grid aperture objectives are monotone in the survival labels, so the all-zero and all-one completions of unknown labels give exact, attained brackets; short-horizon losses decide long-horizon labels while short-horizon survivals stay unknown; lower/upper domination of brackets is a sound Pareto exclusion.
claims.boundary: Finite-table statements about the declared grid and oracle labels only; no continuous-aperture, convergence, model-confidence or speedup claim.

claims.statement: A staged HMBA run (aperture_brackets_hmba.json) applied the checker to three sextupole scalings (0.90, 1.00, 1.10) with a 91-point grid, delta in {0, 0.02} and a 512-turn horizon. Brackets alone excluded nothing before the horizon, since every lower bound is 0; with the nominal setting fully resolved first, the 1.10 scaling was excluded after 16 turns, and 87048 particle-turns were tracked against 117796 for full resolution. Every stage bracket and the exclusion were confirmed against the fully resolved table.
claims.boundary: Illustrative candidates that break chromaticity correction, one launch grid, one horizon, no errors/RF/radiation; not a tuning result, not a multipointBAX comparison.

claims.statement: For a centered cloud and thin kick p -> p + hF, (eps+)^2 = eps^2 + 2ha E[ug] + h^2 a E[g^2] with u = p-(b/a)x, g = F-(E[xF]/a)x, |eps+ - eps| <= |h| sqrt(a E[g^2]); in 4D, det Sigma+ = det A det(S + h(Cov(U,G)+Cov(G,U)) + h^2 Cov(G)) with S the Schur complement.
claims.boundary: Standard covariance algebra checked on rational clouds; no envelope-model, space-charge or simulator claim.

claims.statement: Our own tenfold complete industrial tuning gain over the strongest ordinary workflow remains unestablished.
claims.boundary: Literature ratios, inference speed, query counts, solver-only gains and future proposals cannot substitute for that comparison.
